conviction_note: A small positive lean: Q1 ordinary profit was already 30.5% of a just-raised full-year plan and the yen averaged about 159 through Jul-Sep against the company's 152 assumption, so a second FY raise (with the dividend following it, as in July) is plausible. But the two-analyst IFIS consensus (21.85bn ordinary) already sits 6.6% above the plan, holders are crowded long on margin (信用倍率 78x), and this name gave back most of a strong July beat-and-raise. So p_up is 54 on an abs move of 3.8, which gives +0.30, close to the +0.4 sum of the findings.
bar: Full-year FY3/2027 ordinary profit forecast after this release, against the IFIS consensus of 21,850m yen (2 analysts, both 強気), https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=7283. Company plan is 20,500m (raised from 18,000m on 2026-07-30, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260730/140120260730502688.pdf). Expected revised plan ~21,100m (about 45% odds of a raise to ~21.8bn, otherwise held at 20.5bn), i.e. about -3.5% against the street. The company gives no H1 forecast, so there is no H1 bar. Only two estimates and they could not be cross-checked against 四季報, so the bar is thin.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% disclosed (no position >=0.5%), unchanged at 0.0, as of 2026-10-27 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, via the baseline). 信用倍率 78.27x (kabutan, 2026-10-28), so margin longs are very crowded and margin shorts are negligible. There is no squeeze fuel, and leveraged longs could sell on a disappointment. No options, so no skew. The baseline's priced_lean_pct is -0.567 (margin overhang -0.947, run-up +0.38). The 20-day run-up is -7.6% (2,249 on 9/30 down to 2,044 on 10/27) while the Nikkei made highs, which is sector rotation away from autos.

findings.finding: Q1 FY3/27 ordinary profit was 6,246m yen (+84.6% YoY, 21% above the IFIS Q1 consensus of 5,150m), which is 30.5% of the 20,500m FY plan against 17.8% at the same point last year. The FY plan assumes USD/JPY 152, while the yen averaged about 162.5/158.9/156.4 in Jul/Aug/Sep (and ~158 now). On last year's Q2 run-rate (5,874m OP / 6,441m ordinary) H1 lands near 12bn ordinary, about 59-62% of plan against 51-58% H1 progress in FY3/24-FY3/26. That leaves room for a second FY raise with a dividend increase at this print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-07-30 (15:00): Q1 +84.6% with FY ordinary raised 13.9% and dividend +3 yen. Stock +2.78% prev close to next close, then gave it all back by October. 2025-10-30 H1 print: +0.10%. FY3/24 H1 (2023-10-30) was the one recent H1 print that carried an upward revision (kabutan revision history).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The IFIS consensus of 21,850m already sits above the plan, so a raise that only reaches the street is not new money. What is not priced is the stock itself: it is 7.6% lower over 20 sessions at 8.8x PER and 0.82x PBR, which reads as the market marking autos down rather than discounting a raise. If a raise were priced, the stock would not be sitting 15% under its July post-raise level.
findings.independence: Revision record and Q1 progress from kabutan's financial page, https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=7283&mode=k. FX monthly averages from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/JPY=X?range=6mo&interval=1d. FX assumption from the same 短信 (one document for progress and assumption).

findings.finding: 信用倍率 is 78.27x with the JPX short register at zero: leveraged retail is heavily long and there is no short base to squeeze, so a held forecast (a miss against the 21.85bn street) has sellers and a raise has no forced buyers.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the 2026-07-30 beat-and-raise the stock peaked at an all-time high that week (kabutan 上場来高値 list, 2026-08-01) and then fell ~15% to October, which fits longs selling into strength. Baseline reactions: 6 of the last 8 estimated prints negative.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the baseline lean already carries the margin overhang at -0.947. It is filed because the core rule says to file every sourced fact, and it is sized small because it agrees with the positioning the market can already see.
findings.independence: Baseline positioning block (margin_ratio 78.27, short 0.0), from the same scrape family; none independent.

findings.finding: Toyota's global production fell 5.9% in August 2026 (overseas -7.6%, China sales -22.8%), and Aisan's Asia segment profit was already down 8.8% in Q1. Q2 overseas volume, Asia especially, is a drag on the quarter. The 2026-07-28 Kumamoto M7.1 quake also halted Toyota Kyushu and Tahara into early August.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY3/26 (2025-07-30), when volumes fell and profit dropped 51%: -5.89% prev close to next close. That was a company-level miss, not a public production series.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: Toyota's monthly production is public and the stock has already fallen 7.6% into the print. Toyota's domestic output was up double digits in July and only -1.7% in August, and the weak yen offsets in translation, so net it is a small drag on the rest of the company (Japan + Americas, ~70% of segment sales).
findings.independence: Quake stoppages: https://monoist.itmedia.co.jp/mn/spv/2610/19/news020.html (snippet_only). Q1 Asia segment -8.8% from the Q1 短信 above.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: possible (~45%). The street (IFIS 21.85bn ordinary) is 6.6% above the plan, the yen is ~7 weaker than assumed, and Q1 progress is 30.5%; the company revised at the H1 print in 1 of the last 3 years and already raised in July. Returns: interim 41 yen already set; a dividend raise only comes with a profit raise (35% payout); no buyback pattern at H1 prints. New-year guide: n/a (H1). Quarter vs own 進捗率: H1 likely ~59-62% of FY ordinary plan against 51.1% (FY3/26), 58.5% (FY3/25) and 57.5% (FY3/24).

baseline_tension: The findings lean slightly positive against a negative baseline lean (-0.57, driven by margin overhang) and a -7.6% run-up. The strongest positive the release could carry is a second FY raise with a dividend increase above 83 yen. I looked for it: it is plausible on FX and progress, but the street already expects it, so a hold is the realistic downside. A buyback has no precedent at H1 prints.
lessons_applied: Rule 1: the China/Toyota-production negative rests on Toyota's public monthly series, so it went from -0.4 to -0.2 and its weight left p_up
Rule 1 / core positioning row: the margin-crowding negative is already in the baseline lean, so it went from -0.5 to -0.3

Rule 2: negatives outnumbered positives, so the strongest positive (FY raise + dividend) is written into baseline_tension; I had searched for it, so p_up was not moved for that reason. With the negatives' weight removed, p_up went from 53 to 54 and expected_move from +0.23 to +0.30
Left standing: the +0.9 guidance finding, abs_move 3.8, print_vs_bar -3.5
